# Zerror Studios

> Zerror Studios is a Mumbai-based design-led studio building custom
> websites (GSAP, Three.js, Next.js), custom software and CMS systems,
> and custom eCommerce - including Zcom, its proprietary commerce
> platform. Design and development happen in one team.

## Services
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/website-development):
  Custom, motion-led websites built with GSAP, Three.js and Next.js.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/custom-software-development):
  Headless CMS, dashboards and workflows on the MERN stack.
- [eCommerce Solutions](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/e-commerce):
  Shopify builds and Zcom, Zerror's fully customisable commerce
  platform for pre-orders, drops and live inventory.
- [Branding, Marketing & SEO](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/branding-marketing-and-seo):
  Identity, content, SEO and AI search optimisation.

## Work
- [RPSG Media](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/work/rpsg-media): Custom
  publishing ecosystem for The Hollywood Reporter, Esquire and Robb
  Report India.
- [Manifest](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/work/manifest): WordPress-
  to-custom migration with zero data loss.
- [Salman Khan Films](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/work/salman-khan-films):
  Timeless cinematic showcase website.
- [Deveshe Dreams](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/work/deveshe-dreams):
  Custom eCommerce platform on Zcom.
